title: TAKE shares rally 24% in three weeks as company returns to profitability
description:
Shares of TAKE Ltd have surged nearly 24 per cent in three weeks, hitting the 5 per cent upper circuit for the second consecutive trading session, as investors responded to the company's return to profitability and expansion into preventive healthcare, consumer wellness and technology-led health solutions.
The stock closed at Rs 14.35 on Monday, compared with Rs 11.10 at the beginning of the month, reflecting growing market interest in the company's evolving business strategy and improving financial performance, according to stock exchange data.
TAKE's consolidated profit after tax (PAT) stood at Rs 2.21 crore in the second quarter of FY27, compared with a loss of Rs 62 lakh in the corresponding period last year. Profit more than doubled from Rs 1.06 crore in the preceding quarter. Consolidated total income for the quarter was Rs 29.85 crore, including revenue from operations of Rs 29.41 crore.
